newsitem.title: CANADA: Corriente stock slumps after Monday rise.
newsitem.headline: Corriente stock slumps after Monday rise.

text.p: Corriente Resources Inc on Tuesday lost the sharp gains it made on Monday on what a company spokesman described as disappointment due to unrealistic expectations of gold deposits at its joint venture Argentine copper prospect.
Corriente slumped C$1.85 to C$7.80 in midday trading volue of more than 648,000 shares.
The loss of almost 20 percent of the company's share value capped a rollercoaster ride for the Vancouver-based company.
Corriente shares on Monday soared C$1.45, closing at C$9.65, after the company announced "encouraging" drilling results on its Taca-Taca joint venture copper project in Argentina.
Corriente officials blamed the heightened speculation on investors' misunderstanding of the drill results.

"People are looking for gold values in this, and that makes no sense," said Dan Carriere, the company's spokesperson. The magic of this project is that Corriente is nailing a world-class deposit of enriched copper, Carriere said.
The project in Argentina's Salta province is a joint venture with a unit of Australia's Broken Hill Proprietary Co Ltd, which has an option to earn a 60 percent interest in the property.
